description: This PHP class 'RegistrationEventProcessorFactory' within the OrangeHRM system creates specific registration event processor objects based on the provided event type. It acts as a factory pattern implementation to instantiate appropriate processor classes for handling different registration events related to employee counts.

classes.name: RegistrationEventProcessorFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for creating registration event processor instances based on event type.

methods.name: getRegistrationEventProcessor
methods.description: Returns an appropriate registration event processor instance based on the specified event type.
